arxiv-2111-04795.creator: N. Luber, Sarah Pearson, Mary E. Putman, Gurtina Besla, Sabrina Stierwalt, Joel P. Meyers
arxiv-2111-04795.description: Abstract We present resolved HI synthesis maps from the Very Large Array (VLA) of three interacting dwarf systems: the NGC 3664 dwarf pair, the NGC 3264 dwarf pair, and the UGC 4638 dwarf triplet. All three dwarf systems are captured at various stages of interaction and span a range of environments.

arxiv-2202-08499.title: The Complexity of SPEs in Mean-payoff Games
arxiv-2202-08499.creator: Léonard Brice, Jean-François Raskin, Marie van den Bogaard
arxiv-2202-08499.description: Abstract We establish that the subgame perfect equilibrium (SPE) threshold problem for mean-payoff games is 𝐍𝐏 \mathbf{NP} -complete. While the SPE threshold problem was recently shown to be decidable (in doubly exponential time) and 𝐍𝐏 \mathbf{NP} -hard, its exact worst case complexity was left open. Université Libre de Bruxelles, Belgium leonard.brice@ulb.be Université Libre de Bruxelles, Belgiumjraskin@ulb.ac.

arxiv-2203-04164.title: Weakly Flux-Tunable Superconducting Qubit
arxiv-2203-04164.creator: José M. Chávez-Garcia, Firat Solgun, Jared B. Hertzberg, Oblesh Jinka, Markus Brink, Baleegh Abdo
arxiv-2203-04164.description: Abstract Flux-tunable qubits are a useful resource for superconducting quantum processors. They can be used to perform cPhase gates, facilitate fast reset protocols, avoid qubit-frequency collisions in large processors, and enable certain fast readout schemes. However, flux-tunable qubits suffer from a trade-off between their tunability range and sensitivity to flux noise.

arxiv-2209-06951.title: Spectroscopic r r -Process Abundance Retrieval for Kilonovae I: The Inferred Abundance Pattern of Early Emission from GW170817 approxposterior : Fleming & VanderPlas 2018 ; astropy : Astropy Collaboration et al. 2018 ; cmasher : van der Velden 2020 ; corner : Foreman-Mackey 2016 ; dynesty : Speagle
arxiv-2209-06951.creator: Nicholas Vieira, John J. Ruan, Daryl Haggard, Nicole Ford, Maria R. Drout, Rodrigo Fernández, N. R. Badnell
arxiv-2209-06951.description: Abstract Freshly-synthesized r r -process elements in kilonovae ejecta imprint absorption features on optical spectra, as observed in the GW170817 binary neutron star merger. These spectral features encode insights into the physical conditions of the r r -process and the origins of the ejected material, but associating features with particular elements and inferring the resultant abundance pattern is computationally challenging.

arxiv-2308-05550.description: Abstract The proliferation of short video and live-streaming platforms has revolutionized how consumers engage in online shopping. Instead of browsing product pages, consumers are now turning to rich-content e-commerce, where they can purchase products through dynamic and interactive media like short videos and live streams.

arxiv-2311-14525.creator: M. Markova, P. von Neumann-Cosel, E. Litvinova
arxiv-2311-14525.description: Abstract We present a systematic study of the mass dependence of the low-energy electric dipole strength (LEDS) in Sn isotopes in the range A = 111 − 124 A=111-124 based on data obtained with the Oslo method and with relativistic Coulomb excitation in forward-angle ( p , p ′ p,p^{\prime} ) scattering.

arxiv-2506-05859.title: Impact of the ( ℓ = 2 , m = 0 ) (\ell=2,m=0) spherical harmonic mode with memory on parameter estimation for ground-based detectors
arxiv-2506-05859.creator: Maria Rosselló-Sastre, Sascha Husa, Sayantani Bera, Yumeng Xu
arxiv-2506-05859.description: Abstract We recently presented an efficient and accurate waveform model for the ( 2 , 0 ) (2,0) spherical harmonic mode including both the displacement memory contribution and the ringdown oscillations for aligned-spin binary black holes in quasi-circular orbits. The model we developed is constructed in time domain and implemented within the computationally efficient IMRPhenomTHM waveform model.

arxiv-2507-05959.title: Limit theorems for toral partially hyperbolic endomorphisms Thanks: RC’s research was partially supported by the research project ‘Dynamics and Information Research Institute—Quantum Information, Quantum Technologies’ within the agreement between UniCredit Bank and Scuola Normale Superiore and by th
arxiv-2507-05959.creator: Roberto Castorrini (1), Kasun Fernando (2)
arxiv-2507-05959.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Roberto Castorrini (1), Kasun Fernando (2). Under natural assumptions on the observable, we prove a Central Limit Theorem, a Berry-Esseen Theorem, and a quantitative Local Limit Theorem for a broad class of partially hyperbolic endomorphisms of the two-dimensional torus. Our results apply, but are not limited to, skew-products and their perturbations, and they remain valid even when the system admits multiple, though finitely many, absolutely continuous ergodic invariant measures.

arxiv-2508-06768.title: DiffUS: Differentiable Ultrasound Rendering from Volumetric Imaging
arxiv-2508-06768.creator: Noe Bertramo, Gabriel Duguey, Vivek Gopalakrishnan
arxiv-2508-06768.description: Abstract Intraoperative ultrasound imaging provides real-time guidance during numerous surgical procedures, but its interpretation is complicated by noise, artifacts, and poor alignment with high-resolution preoperative MRI/CT scans. To bridge the gap between preoperative planning and intraoperative guidance, we present DiffUS, a physics-based, differentiable ultrasound renderer that synthesizes realistic B-mode images from volumetric imaging.

arxiv-2510-02631.title: Deep Generative Continual Learning using Functional LoRA: FunLoRA
arxiv-2510-02631.creator: Victor Enescu, Hichem Sahbi
arxiv-2510-02631.description: Abstract Continual adaptation of deep generative models holds tremendous potential and critical importance, given their rapid and expanding usage in text and vision based applications. Incremental training, however, remains highly challenging due to catastrophic forgetting phenomenon, which makes it difficult for neural networks to effectively incorporate new knowledge.

arxiv-2511-08940.title: QIBONN: A Quantum-Inspired Bilevel Optimizer for Neural Networks on Tabular Classification * Equal Contribution.
arxiv-2511-08940.creator: Pedro Chumpitaz-Flores *, My Duong *, Ying Mao, Kaixun Hua
arxiv-2511-08940.description: Abstract Hyperparameter optimization (HPO) for neural networks on tabular data is critical to a wide range of applications, yet it remains challenging due to large, non-convex search spaces and the cost of exhaustive tuning. We introduce the Quantum-Inspired Bilevel Optimizer for Neural Networks (QIBONN), a bilevel framework that encodes feature selection, architectural hyperparameters, and regularization in a unified qubit-based representation.

arxiv-2511-14303.title: Some stability properties of Hamiltonian Poisson integrators
arxiv-2511-14303.creator: Oscar Cosserat
arxiv-2511-14303.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Oscar Cosserat. Hamiltonian Poisson integrators are Poisson integrators that admit a modified Hamiltonian. In this article, we illustrate the importance of the existence of a modified Hamiltonian for Poisson integrators in the context of integrable and non-integrable systems. Examples of Hamiltonian systems are provided by Lotka-Volterra dynamics; in order to investigate stability properties of Hamiltonian Poisson integrators on non-integrable systems, we exhibit a non-integrable 5 5 -dimensional Lotka-Volterra system and pursue numerical investigations of it.

pmc-11354304.description: The present study examined three hallucinogenic amphetamine derivatives, namely, 2,5-dimethoxy-4-iodoamphetamine (DOI) as well as 2,5-dimethoxy-4-methylamphetamine (DOM) and 4-methylmethcathinone (mephedrone).
